issues.description: All 28 existing extraction candidates are ordinary lung cell markers (AT1/AT2, DATP, cycling/ECM epithelia, basal, tuft, pathological fibroblasts, macrophages) and are outside the project scope. The target_cell_scope is unspecified, so only PNS/neuroendocrine/enteroendocrine/pulmonary neuroendocrine cell markers could be included.
Fig. 1b 与 Methods 确认存在 Neuronal cells 且使用 FindAllMarkers positive markers 注释，但当前材料未给出具体基因及 PNS 亚型，需补充 DEG/source data。

Several candidates originally categorized as context_only/cluster_enriched (e.g., cycling epithelium genes, ECMhigh genes, KRT5/TP63, CHAT/POU2F3, CD45/CD64) are actually used by the authors to annotate or quantify cells; however, this evidence correction does not affect the exclusion decision because all are out of project scope.
